title: Lava Dogs Conquer Range 400
description: U.S. Marines with Company C, 1st Battalion, 3rd Marine Regiment, conduct a company level live fire exercise during Integrated Training Exercise (ITX) aboard Marine Corps Air Ground Combat Center Twentynine Palms, Calif., July 29, 2015. ITX is conducted to enhance the integration and warfighting capability from all elements of the Marine Air Ground Task Force. (U.S. Marine Corps motion imagery produced by Lance Cpl. Akeel Austin/Released)
